subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: E-commerce are promote our domestic business very soon. Buyers and sellers may not required to talk face to face. It is a tiny part of e-commerce. Online shopping, nowadays will be defined as a business process through electric transmission. It rapidly being spread in our country.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Online shopping, nowadays is rapidly being spread in our country. (b) It is a tiny part of e-commerce. (c) E-commerce may be defined as a business process through electric transmission. (d) Buyers and sellers are not required to talk face to face. (e) It will promote our domestic business very soon.
